description: A financing attempt not routed through the authorized CashflowLendingVenue -- models something calling registry.consume() directly, bypassing the onlyVenue modifier. Must be rejected before claim state or amount are even considered, since onlyVenue is a modifier gating entry to the whole function.
note: Claim state built on the real Gate 1 stream, fully undrawn and otherwise perfectly valid -- the only thing wrong is viaAuthorizedVenue.
